candidate_gate: Total/positive correct strictly improve over zero; negative correct does not decrease; negative false positives do not increase; invalid=0. Filter eligibility before rank, ties earlier trial/step.
heldout_protocol: Freeze one candidate based only on dev; official task_last zero+candidate,64 raw generations complete and integrity verified before first gold score. No post-heldout candidate reselection or training.
execution_schedule: Future run must use a newly pinned deadline covering training and complete natural-generation dev/heldout evaluations. Prepared configs retain current expiring deadline and cannot silently auto-resume. No scheduled/background job remains.
